caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the Average Speech Recognition (ASR) score resulting from the use of different triggers on the horizontal axis, with the triggers arranged in ascending order according to the ASR score of the clean model. The x-axis ranges from 0.2 to 0.8, marked with a linear scale and tick intervals of 0.1, representing ASR values. The y-axis spans from 0.2 to 0.8, also using a linear scale with tick intervals of 0.1, representing ASR scores. A solid blue line, marked with teal circles, begins at approximately 0.38 and decreases to approximately 0.22 near the end of the x-axis. A solid orange line, marked with orange crosses, initiates at approximately 0.18 and decreases to approximately 0.09. A solid purple line, marked with purple circles, begins at approximately 0.42 and decreases to approximately 0.3. Finally, a solid green line, marked with green crosses, starts at approximately 0.1 and decreases to approximately 0.03.
